text: {"assertions":["A layout bug in the email renderer (notifications/email/render.py) caused table overflow in plain text when rendering digest templates with long subjects.","The table overflow issue specifically occurred when jobs were scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause was identified as an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The bug fix was implemented in PR #1579 on the fix/broken-layout-1 branch and included a property test to cover the issue.","After the fix was deployed, the associated alert remained stable for 40 consecutive days.","Property test coverage for the off-by-one fix was added to tests/notifications/test_render.py.","The notifications system is written in Python."]}
